name: Benchy calibration boat
description: A small tugboat for testing bridges, overhangs, dimensional accuracy and surface finish on an FDM printer.

name: Gridfinity parts bin
description: A square open container for sorting screws and electronic components in a modular workshop drawer.

name: M042
description: A hinged lid and latch close this protective container around an Arduino circuit board. Holes allow USB and power cables through.

name: Headphone desk hook
description: A curved support clamps beneath a desk to hang over-ear headphones out of the way.

name: Filament spool roller
description: Two bearing-supported wheels allow a large plastic filament reel to rotate smoothly while feeding the extruder.

name: Articulated dragon
description: A long fantasy creature with wings and linked body segments. Flexible joints print together without assembly.

name: Phone stand
description: An angled cradle holds a smartphone upright on a table for watching video. A slot routes the charging cable.

name: Plant watering tray
description: A shallow round dish catches water that drains through the holes under an indoor flower pot.

name: Hex bit organizer
description: A desktop rack with holes for screwdriver bits, arranged in labelled rows by tool size.

name: Vase spiral
description: A decorative twisted flower vessel with a continuous thin wall, designed for single-wall spiral printing.

name: M017
description: A toothed circular wheel engages another wheel to transfer rotary motion. The center bore fits a six-millimeter shaft.

name: Cable comb
description: A row of narrow channels keeps several electrical wires parallel and prevents tangles behind a computer.

name: Lithophane night light
description: A curved relief panel forms a portrait when illuminated from behind by a small LED lamp.

name: Pegboard drill mount
description: A bracket with two rear hooks suspends a cordless power drill on a perforated workshop wall.

name: Cookie cutter star
description: A hollow five-point outline presses through rolled pastry dough to create star-shaped biscuits.

name: M099
description: A narrow wedge fits beneath a door to stop it swinging shut. The ribbed underside grips the floor.

name: Dice tower
description: A tall hollow castle channels tabletop gaming dice through internal ramps into a catch tray.

name: Laptop riser
description: Two angled supports lift a portable computer above the desk and leave its underside open for cooling airflow.

name: Battery dispenser
description: A gravity-fed rack stores AA cells and presents the oldest cell at the bottom opening.

name: M023
description: A rotating ring attaches a small camera to a bicycle handlebar. A captive nut tightens the split clamp.

name: Round coaster
description: A flat circular drink mat protects a table from hot mugs and water marks. Raised edges contain drips.

name: Drawer divider
description: An adjustable partition separates kitchen utensils in a shallow drawer. Sliding tabs fit different drawer widths.

name: Chess knight
description: A stylized horse head sits on a round weighted base for use as a playing piece on a chessboard.

name: Calibration cube
description: A twenty-millimeter cube marked X, Y and Z for checking axis dimensions and extrusion settings.

name: Wall key rack
description: Five hooks hold household keys beside the entrance. Two screw holes secure the back plate to the wall.

name: Toothbrush holder
description: A ventilated bathroom cup holds four toothbrushes upright and drains excess water through its base.

name: Book page holder
description: A small wing-shaped accessory slips over the thumb and keeps the pages of a paperback spread open.

name: Pet food scoop
description: A deep measuring spoon with a long handle transfers dry animal food from a storage bag to a feeding bowl.

name: Vacuum hose adapter
description: A stepped hollow coupling joins a shop vacuum hose to the dust outlet of a sanding tool.

name: SD card wallet
description: A pocket-sized case protects eight removable camera memory cards in separate slots under a snap lid.

name: Filament drying box
description: A sealed reel enclosure contains desiccant packs and a humidity meter to keep printing filament dry.

name: Paint bottle rack
description: A tiered shelf displays small model-paint bottles so their color labels remain visible.
